lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ is in the derivative form: كُبْكِبَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ب/ك/ب k–b–k–b (also see ب/ب/ ك k–b–b) to throw something face down, to throw in a pit, to throw on top of 1 another; to be wrapped up, to be mixed up, a great number. Of this root, كُبْكِبُوا kubkibū occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كُبْكِبَ kubkiba [pass. quad. v.] to be gathered and thrown (into an abyss) on top of one another

(26:94) فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ and then they will all be thrown headlong into it [Hell], they and those who misled them.
